title: Strata Portal: Wayfinding and Workspace Transition Patterns
creator: Maya Chen
description: This ticket scopes a high-fidelity exploration of a 'Strata Portal' navigation pattern for the Redwood Console focused on faster wayfinding, predictable workspace context switching, and surfaced cost + rollout lenses. Problem: users find it hard to jump between workspaces and reach dashboard rollouts or cost breakdowns in <3 clicks; routing inconsistencies across hosted/dedicated/private views cause mistakes. Goal: propose a compact, progressive navigation surface that preserves deep links, supports keyboard quick-jump, and makes rollout/cost controls discoverable without adding visual noise. Design constraints: must work with existing left rail and topbar, be responsive down to 1024px wide workspaces, respect role-based visibility (admin, viewer), and not require backend schema changes for initial rollout. Deliverables: design mockups for primary/secondary rail states, interaction spec for workspace switching (pin, ephemeral preview, session restore), prototype demonstrating keyboard jump + breadcrumb, and a small usability script for 8–12 participants.
acceptance_criteria: Primary prototype shows: left-rail compact and expanded states, workspace switcher with pinned workspaces, and rollout shortcut
Cost lens reachable from nav within two interactions for high-frequency users
Keyboard-driven quick-jump with fuzzy search implemented in prototype and tested in lab
Design spec includes edge-case flows: cross-tenant switch, insufficient permissions, and session restore after failure
Sign-off from PM (Luis Ortega), Eng lead (Samir Patel), and Security (Rina Shah)
comments: 2025-02-18 Maya Chen: Initial draft — sketched three patterns: nested rail, portal overlay, and flyout quick-jump. Preference leaning to portal overlay for density + discoverability.

2025-02-21 Amira Johnson: Pulled telemetry — current median workspace switch time 8.4s; error rate when switching between private vs hosted workspaces ~6%. We should aim to reduce to <4s and <2% error rate.
2025-02-24 Samir Patel (ENG): Concern about making backend calls on hover for ephemeral preview; suggested client-side cached metadata + on-demand fetch to avoid extra load on runtime control plane.
2025-02-25 Luis Ortega (PM): Request to surface 'last deployment' and 'cost delta' per workspace in the quick-jump UI. Keep sensitive metrics hidden for viewer roles.

2025-02-27 Usability lab note (Maya): First prototype tested with 6 participants — portal overlay reduced time-to-target by 27% vs baseline. Confusion on the difference between "Pin" and "Favorite" — rename to "Pin (Dock)" per feedback.
2025-02-28 Rina Shah (Security): RBAC checklist added. Recommend a soft-lock: hide cost lens actions for viewer role and require additional confirmation for cross-tenant rollouts.
2025-03-01 Amira Johnson: Updated prototype links in attachments and uploaded flow spec. Ready for ENG review and spike to implement cached metadata layer.
decisions: Adopt portal overlay pattern as primary solution; fallback compact rail remains for narrow widths
Use client-side cached workspace metadata for immediate previews; fetch fresh details on selection
Expose cost delta and last-deploy timestamp in quick-jump for admin roles only
Rename 'Favorite' to 'Pin (Dock)' and provide ephemeral 'Preview' on hover/keyboard focus
next_steps: ENG spike: implement metadata cache and a lightweight preview API (assigned to Samir, estimate 3 days)
UX: finalize microcopy, error states, and RBAC affordances (Amira, 2 days)
PM: schedule 2-week A/B test gating criteria and success metrics (Luis)
Research: recruit 8–12 participants for remote usability test, run script and upload recordings to Confluence
